title: 65_HS1-834228961_62-HQ-83894_Section_7
doc_notes: This document is an FBI case file (62-83894) containing various reports, correspondence, and internal memoranda regarding unidentified flying objects (UFOs) and flying saucers from 1952-1953, confirming the presence of encounter-related content. / This document is a collection of FBI case files and correspondence regarding UFO reports, including internal routing slips and public inquiries.

encounters.summary: Two employees of the E. I. DuPont Company observed a saucer-shaped object with a blue light and orange fringe flying at high speed over the Savannah River Plant.
A scoutmaster reported an unidentified object 30 feet in diameter hovering over him; he claimed it shot a 'red blob' that caused him to lose consciousness, leaving his cap burned and arm hair singed.
A witness reported seeing a pale yellow object that fell toward Earth, moved horizontally, and then rose and disappeared into space.
Three objects, one large and two small, observed over Franklin, Indiana, performing aerial maneuvers for over four hours.
encounters.entity_appearance: round and flat, one large yellowish-white, two smaller orange and red
encounters.entity_behavior: barrel rolls, loops, spins, 90 and 45 degree turns, hovering
encounters.quote: dancing up and down as if someone was playing with a giant yo-yo

encounters.summary: A disc-shaped object sighted in the East of Los Angeles, remaining stationary before moving north.
encounters.entity_appearance: disc shaped, yellowish-white, 50 feet in diameter
encounters.quote: remained in a stationary position for about 4 seconds

encounters.summary: A large metal ball landed in Charleston, West Virginia; two small men in red emerged from a trap in the top.
encounters.entity_behavior: emerged from trap, climbed tree, looked around, re-entered craft
encounters.quote: two small men in red emerged from a trap in the top

encounters.summary: Three small animals encountered on Bankhead Highway near Mableton, Georgia; one killed by automobile.
encounters.entity_appearance: 21 inches long, pointed head, large ears, pinkish skin, no hair
encounters.quote: looked as if it belonged to monkey family
